sources.snippet: ControlNet Online ControlNet is a neural network structure to control diffusion models by adding extra conditions, a game changer for AI Image generation. It brings unprecedented levels of control to Stable Diffusion. The revolutionary thing about ControlNet is its solution to the problem of spatial consistency.
